# semaphore_ex_project_secret_storage_connection_test (Action)

Tests one project secret-storage connection explicitly. The action does not retain or expose provider credentials, tokens, or connection response details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_secret_storage_connection_test" "vault" {
  config {
    project_id = 1
    storage_id = 2
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_secret_storage_connection_test.vault
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the target.
- `storage_id` (Number) Secret storage connection to test.
